name: Double or Nothing
rules: Two players compete in a Cambridge Vice-Chancellor election across 12 colleges, each with a specified number of Fellows. Each player simultaneously allocates up to 100 pennies among the colleges, using non-negative integers. A player wins a college only by donating a positive amount at least twice the opponent's donation; if neither player meets this condition, neither receives the Fellows' votes. The player with more total Fellows' votes wins; equal totals result in a draw. Invalid allocations automatically lose; if both allocations are invalid, the game is a draw.
